headline: Apple lists multiple Wireless Silicon Digital Mixed-Signal Modeling roles
fact: Apple listed Wireless Silicon Digital Mixed-Signal Modeling Engineer roles in the San Francisco Bay Area and Beaverton on July 16. Related October 16 role 200689643 assigns accurate, simulation-efficient SystemVerilog models for analog/RF blocks, reusable monitors/checkers, test-plan execution, debug and flow automation. It explicitly develops emulation-ready models and requests understanding of synthesis-ready mixed-signal model requirements, with SystemC/C++ and high-level synthesis among preferred skills. These related postings are grouped with the existing wireless modeling mandate; the later role does not establish successful emulator execution or change the July Event date.
